rationale: The agent verified the user by matching full name and zip code to a single account, then correctly checked the user’s orders with read-only tools. It identified that the only delivered order was a digital camera and that the laptop order was still pending, so a return could not be processed. The agent did not fabricate any order details and took no write actions without confirmation. Given the discrepancy between the user’s claim (laptop in hand) and system records (no delivered laptop), the agent appropriately offered and executed a handoff to a human agent, which is allowed when the request cannot be fulfilled via available tools. While the agent could have also offered to cancel the pending laptop order per the user’s initial fallback request, choosing to escalate due to the data mismatch is reasonable and within policy. Overall, the interaction adhered to policy and ended with a successful transfer to a human agent.
